# SPOL Publish prototype

> Clickable static prototype of the SPOL Accreditation Publish workflow (landing, four steps, published state) with its specification set. All people, institutions and documents are fictional.

## Specifications (Markdown, for ingestion)

- [Developer handoff](https://rajatcord.github.io/spol-publish-prototype/docs/handoff.md): data model, states and gates, every screen control by control, API, credits and ledger, audit, accessibility, acceptance tests, answers for the build team (report download format, comment structure, send-back email, severity definitions, free checks), open questions, iteration log.
- [AI call spec](https://rajatcord.github.io/spol-publish-prototype/docs/ai-spec.md): the three model calls (reviewer analysis, consistency, Auto-format), schemas, validation, keys and versions, cost, safety, quality gates.
- [How AI readiness works](https://rajatcord.github.io/spol-publish-prototype/docs/dossier.md): the user-facing dossier.
- [Flows](https://rajatcord.github.io/spol-publish-prototype/docs/flows.md): every path through the workflow, screen by screen.
